title: Upma
description: Roasted semolina cooked with a tempering of mustard, chana dal, onions and tomatoes.

steps.title: Roast rava
steps.text: Roast the semolina (rava) with a little ghee until fragrant, then set aside.

steps.title: Prep vegetables
steps.text: Chop the onions, green chillies, tomatoes and fresh coriander.

steps.title: Tempering
steps.text: Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds, split chana dal and asafoetida.

steps.title: Sauté vegetables
steps.text: Add the chopped onions and salt. Sauté until the onions are soft and cooked.

steps.title: Boil & cook
steps.text: Pour in the required water and bring it to a rolling boil. Slowly add the roasted semolina while stirring continuously to prevent lumps, cover and cook until done. Top with fresh coriander.
